scope: Independent review of final frozen Actor-query study, native path 1:147/1:367 and its bounded arithmetic/output claims, including final annotations, claims, verifier and manifest. No uncaptured transitive collision closure.

findings.conclusion: Limit<=0 or unordered NaN with masked invalid exception bypasses the direct output copy. This check occurs after Actor reads and helper calls.
Mode false and query+116 bit0 can break before output copy; first break yields no fresh direct output, later break leaves prior iteration output. Mode true skips that break test.
After normal helper return, adapter ignores its success flag and returns encoded shared buffer 756B48 plus @ADR tag unconditionally. It does not initialize the result buffer.
Separate adapter 42B7B0 is a concrete second writer/returner of the same buffer. Captured positive xrefs are not an exhaustive transitive writer census.

First reached RN-even fixed point is 2^31. Strict binary32 limit>2^31 or +Inf keeps MINSS at this value and JA true if helpers return normally, registers/rounding remain stable, relevant exceptions are masked, and no early flag break occurs. Equality exits normally.

mathematicalResult.requires: Fixed RN-even; all helpers return; no earlier flag break; relevant floating-point exceptions masked; normal preserved registers.

recommendation: A future caller should validate a finite practical limit and explicit success, then copy successful output to caller-owned storage. A native hardening change needs a progress/iteration guard and defined failure result; no patch is included.

resolvedObservations.resolution: Final report, annotation and model scope explicitly require relevant masked SSE exceptions, including precision/inexact, and stable RN-even. Claim limitations repeat this condition. No native bytes or model cases changed.
